fullPassage: How much time do you spend sitting per day? Studies have found that one-third of the global population aged fifteen years and older engage in insufficient physical activity. In particular, teenagers spend too much of their time sitting down and seldom do they engage in active physical activities on a regular basis. The scientific community has even coined the term “sitting disease” for this phenomenon in order to represent the harmful health effects that result from long periods of sitting. The longer you sit, the more exposed you are to the dangers of obesity, heart disease, diabetes, and even depression. Walking, according to health experts, is one of the safest, easiest, and cheapest forms of exercise to combat sitting disease. Walking is not only a simple way to avoid the harmful effects of sitting disease, but it also has other health benefits. You may already be aware of the health benefits of walking, such as bone strengthening, blood pressure reduction, and improved heart health. But did you know that walking can help lower your cravings for sugary foods? According to research by the University of Exeter, taking daily walks for fifteen minutes can cut chocolate consumption in half. This is because frequent physical activity can enhance brain function, making it easier to limit our consumption of sweet foods such as chocolate. Moreover, walking can keep you from getting sick during the cold and flu season. A study found that people who walked for at least twenty minutes a day, five days a week, had 43% fewer sick days than those who exercised once a week or less. And even if they did get sick, it was for a shorter period of time with milder symptoms. This is primarily due to the improved immune system that results from walking regularly. In addition to the physical benefits, walking has been found to improve our creativity. Researchers at Stanford University presented data on the association between walking and creativity. The participants who walked for five to sixteen minutes showed an average increase in creativity, compared to those who remained sitting. This was mainly because the areas of the brain responsible for learning and memory worked more efficiently when people walked. It is no wonder that Steve Jobs came up with some of his most brilliant ideas while walking, and much of his company’s design process was developed during walking meetings with his staff. Despite the importance and benefits of walking, as students, finding the time to include it in your daily lives may appear challenging or bothersome. Even when you have time, you may dismiss the thought of walking. Instead of walking, you might prefer to connect with friends on social media or watch TV at home. But walking can be fun. Here are some simple ways to make walking enjoyable for you. Get Your Groove On A “music walk” is a great way to make walking feel less like a workout. All you will need is a smartphone with a music streaming app and a good pair of walking shoes. Additionally, you can bring a pair of earphones in case other people are disturbed or annoyed by your music. You can create playlists for different moods or circumstances. Are you going for a walk at sunset by the lake? Create a playlist of calm and relaxing tunes to help you appreciate the peaceful environment. Going for a power walk to enjoy the autumn breeze? Fill your playlist with energetic songs that will motivate you to walk harder. So grab your phone, put on your walking shoes, and let the rhythm move you! Walk and Talk Having a walking buddy can really motivate you to lace up the sneakers if you feel lonely or bored when walking alone. When you make plans to walk with a friend, you are more likely to follow through since you do not want to let your friend down. Additionally, having someone to chat with can help you forget that you are even exercising, making the time fly by. You will find yourself so engaged in conversation that you will not even realize how far you have walked. Moreover, with a friend by your side, you will have someone to share the beauty of your surroundings with, making your walks more exciting and engaging. Make It a Challenge Set a goal for the number of steps you want to take per day or week, and then work toward it. Using a smartphone app, keep track of your daily steps. Increasing your step count over a few weeks would be challenging yet rewarding. You do not need to set aside time for this walking challenge. You can take part in the challenge by walking during your lunch break, taking the stairs instead of the elevator, or walking in place while brushing your teeth. You can even make walking a social media challenge and get others to join you.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① seldom they engage → seldom do they engage: 부정어 seldom이 문장 앞에 오면 주어와 조동사를 도치해야 한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① seldom they engage → seldom do they engage: seldom(좀처럼 ~않다) 같은 부정어가 문장 맨 앞에 나오면 그 뒤는 '조동사 + 주어 + 동사'로 순서를 뒤집어야 해요. 그래서 'seldom do they engage'가 맞고, 도치가 없는 'seldom they engage'는 틀려요 ← 정답

✅ ② coined: 'The scientific community has even coined the term'에서 현재완료(has + p.p.)로 알맞아요

✅ ③ exposed: 'the more exposed you are'에서 '~에 노출되다(be exposed to)'의 과거분사로 알맞아요

✅ ④ is one of: 주어가 동명사 Walking(단수)이므로 단수 동사 is가 알맞아요
det.tip: 부정어(seldom) + 조동사(do) + 주어(they) + 동사(engage) 도치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② can helps lower → can help lower: 조동사 can 뒤에는 항상 동사원형을 쓴다
det.analysis:
✅ ① improved: 'improved heart health'에서 명사 health를 꾸미는 과거분사(개선된)로 알맞아요

❌ ② can helps lower → can help lower: 조동사 can 뒤에는 -s를 붙이지 않은 동사원형을 써야 해요. 그래서 'can help'가 맞고 'can helps'는 틀려요 ← 정답

✅ ③ making it easier to limit: 'making it easier to limit our consumption'에서 it은 가목적어, to limit이 진목적어인 분사구문으로 알맞아요

✅ ④ getting: 'keep you from getting sick'에서 '전치사 from + 동명사(-ing)'로 알맞아요
det.tip: 조동사(can) + 동사원형(help). can helps 불가

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ participants which walked → participants who walked: 선행사가 사람(participants)이므로 주격 관계대명사는 who
det.analysis:

✅ ② presented: 'Researchers ~ presented data'에서 과거 시제 동사로 알맞아요

❌ ③ participants which walked → participants who walked: 관계대명사가 가리키는 앞말이 participants(참가자들, 사람)예요. 사람을 가리키는 주격 관계대명사는 who이므로 which는 틀려요. which는 사물을 가리킬 때 써요 ← 정답

✅ ④ was developed: 주어가 'much of his company's design process'(단수)이므로 단수 수동태 was developed가 알맞아요
det.tip: 사람 선행사(participants) → 주격 관계대명사 who / 사물 → which

스티브 잡스는 걷는 동안 가장 뛰어난 아이디어를 떠올리곤 했다.

questions.passage: Studies have found that one-third of the global population aged fifteen years and older engage in insufficient physical activity.  In particular, teenagers spend too much of their time sitting down and seldom do they engage in active physical activities on a regular basis.  The scientific community has even coined the term “sitting disease” for this phenomenon in order to represent the harmful health effects that result from long periods of sitting.  The longer you sit, the more exposed you are to the dangers of obesity, heart disease, diabetes, and even depression.  Walking, according to health experts, is one of the safest, easiest, and cheapest forms of exercise to combat sitting disease.  Walking is not only a simple way to avoid the harmful effects of sitting disease, but it also has other health benefits.  You may already be aware of the health benefits of walking, such as bone strengthening, blood pressure reduction, and improved heart health.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 걷기와 신체 활동에 관한 사실 확인.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'blood pressure reduction, and improved heart health'에서 걷기는 혈압을 '낮추고' 심장 건강을 '개선한다'고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ② 본문 'teenagers ~ seldom do they engage in active physical activities'에서 십대들은 활발한 활동을 '좀처럼 하지 않는다'고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ③ 본문 'one-third of the global population ~ engage in insufficient physical activity'에서 3분의 1은 '부족한' 신체 활동을 한다고 했으므로 불일치

✅ ④ 본문 'Walking ~ is one of the safest, easiest, and cheapest forms of exercise'와 일치 ← 정답
det.tip: insufficient(부족한), seldom(좀처럼 ~않다), reduction/improved(낮추고 개선)로 오답을 거르세요.

ch: 걷기는 혈압을 높여 오히려 심장 건강을 악화시킨다.
십대들은 규칙적으로 활발한 신체 활동에 자주 참여한다.
세계 인구의 3분의 1은 충분한 신체 활동을 하고 있다.
걷기는 가장 안전하고 쉽고 값싼 운동 형태 중 하나이다.

questions.passage: Using a smartphone app, you can ①<u>keep</u> track of your daily steps. Increasing your step count over a few weeks ②<u>being</u> challenging yet rewarding. You do not need ③<u>to set</u> aside time for this walking challenge. You can take part by walking during your lunch break or ④<u>taking</u> the stairs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② being → would be: 문장의 주어(Increasing ~)에 이어질 정동사가 필요하므로 would be
det.analysis:
✅ ① keep: 'you can keep track of'에서 조동사 can 뒤 동사원형으로 알맞아요

❌ ② being → would be: 'Increasing your step count over a few weeks ___ challenging yet rewarding'에서 동명사 주어(Increasing ~) 뒤에는 문장을 완성하는 정동사가 필요해요. being(현재분사)은 정동사가 될 수 없으므로 would be로 고쳐야 해요 ← 정답

✅ ③ to set: 'You do not need to set aside time'에서 'need to + 동사원형'으로 알맞아요

✅ ④ taking: 'by walking ~ or taking the stairs'에서 전치사 by에 이어지는 동명사 walking과 병렬을 이루어 알맞아요
det.tip: 주어(Increasing ~) 뒤에는 정동사(would be)가 필요. being은 정동사 아님

questions.passage: In addition to the physical benefits, walking has been found to improve our creativity.  Researchers at Stanford University presented data on the association between walking and creativity.  The participants who walked for five to sixteen minutes showed an average increase in creativity, compared to those who remained sitting.  This was mainly because the areas of the brain responsible for learning and memory worked more efficiently when people walked.  It is no wonder that Steve Jobs came up with some of his most brilliant ideas while walking, and much of his company’s design process was developed during walking meetings with his staff.  Despite the importance and benefits of walking, as students, finding the time to include it in your daily lives may appear challenging or bothersome.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 걷기가 신체적 이점 외에 향상시킨다고 밝혀진 것을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 걷기가 향상시키는 것.
det.analysis: 본문 'In addition to the physical benefits, walking has been found to improve our creativity.'에서 걷기는 신체적 이점에 더해 '창의력(creativity)'을 향상시킨다고 밝혀졌어요. 뒤이어 스탠퍼드 대학 연구로 이를 뒷받침해요.
det.tip: improve our creativity(창의력을 향상시키다)에서 creativity를 찾아요.

questions.passage: Studies have found that one-third of the global population aged fifteen years and older engage in insufficient physical activity.  In particular, teenagers spend too much of their time sitting down and seldom do they engage in active physical activities on a regular basis. The longer you sit, the more exposed you are to the dangers of obesity, heart disease, diabetes, and even depression.  Walking, according to health experts, is one of the safest, easiest, and cheapest forms of exercise to combat sitting disease.  Walking is not only a simple way to avoid the harmful effects of sitting disease, but it also has other health benefits.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 과학계가 오래 앉아 있는 것의 해로운 건강 영향을 나타내기 위해 만들어 낸 용어를 본문에서 찾아 두 단어로 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 과학계가 만들어 낸 용어.
det.analysis: 본문 'The scientific community has even coined the term "sitting disease" for this phenomenon in order to represent the harmful health effects that result from long periods of sitting.'에서 과학계는 오래 앉아 있는 것의 해로운 건강 영향을 나타내기 위해 'sitting disease(앉아 있는 병)'라는 용어를 만들어 냈어요.
det.tip: coined the term "sitting disease"(sitting disease라는 용어를 만들다)

questions.passage: But did you know that walking can help lower your cravings for __________ (sugar) foods? According to research by the University of Exeter, taking daily walks for fifteen minutes can cut chocolate consumption in half.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: sugary (형용사, 달콤한).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 빈칸은 바로 뒤의 명사 foods(음식)를 꾸미는 자리예요. 명사를 꾸미는 자리에는 형용사가 와야 해요. 그래서 명사 sugar(설탕)를 형용사 sugary(달콤한, 설탕이 든)로 바꿔 'sugary foods(달콤한 음식)'로 써야 해요.
det.tip: 명사(foods)를 꾸미는 자리 → 명사 sugar를 형용사 sugary로

In particular, teenagers spend too much of their time sitting down and seldom do they engage in active physical activities on a regular basis. questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 스마트폰 사용의 위험은 글의 소재가 아니에요

❌ ② 스트레칭 운동법은 본문에 나오지 않아요

✅ ③ 앉아 있는 병의 위험을 짚고, 걷기의 신체적·정신적 이점을 소개한 뒤, 걷기를 즐겁게 하는 방법(음악·친구·도전)을 제시하는 것이 글 전체의 주제예요 ← 정답

❌ ④ 걷기 회의는 스티브 잡스 사례의 일부일 뿐 전체 주제가 아니에요
det.tip: 걷기의 이점 + 걷기를 즐기는 방법이 글 전체를 관통해요.

ch: 십대가 스마트폰을 오래 사용하는 것의 위험성
오래 앉아 일하는 사무직 근로자를 위한 스트레칭 운동법
걷기가 주는 몸과 마음의 다양한 이점과 걷기를 즐겁게 하는 방법
유명 기업가들이 회의를 진행하는 여러 가지 방식

In particular, teenagers spend too much of their time sitting down and seldom do they engage in active physical activities on a regular basis. questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 스탠퍼드 연구는 창의력 향상의 근거일 뿐, 그 방법을 따라야 한다는 것이 요지는 아니에요

❌ ② 걷기의 효과는 누구에게나 해당하므로 '전문 운동선수에게만'은 틀려요

❌ ③ 사교 모임 늘리기는 걷기를 즐기는 한 방법일 뿐 요지가 아니에요

✅ ④ 걷기는 점심시간·계단 이용처럼 특별한 시간이나 비용 없이도 할 수 있고, 신체 건강·면역·창의력 등 몸과 마음에 두루 이롭다는 것이 요지예요 ← 정답
det.tip: 특별한 시간·비용 없이 실천 가능 + 몸과 마음에 두루 이로움

ch: 창의력을 높이려면 반드시 스탠퍼드 대학의 연구 방법을 따라야 한다.
걷기의 건강 효과는 전문 운동선수에게만 나타난다.
사교 모임을 늘리는 것이 건강을 지키는 가장 좋은 방법이다.
걷기는 특별한 시간이나 비용 없이도 실천할 수 있는, 몸과 마음에 두루 이로운 운동이다.

questions.passage: Walk and Talk Having a walking buddy can really motivate you to lace up the sneakers if you feel lonely or bored when walking alone.  When you make plans to walk with a friend, you are more likely to follow through since you do not want to let your friend down.  Additionally, having someone to chat with can help you forget that you are even exercising, making the time fly by.  You will find yourself so engaged in conversation that __________.  Moreover, with a friend by your side, you will have someone to share the beauty of your surroundings with, making your walks more exciting and engaging.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'당신은 자신이 얼마나 멀리 걸었는지조차 깨닫지 못할 것이다.'

[조건]
(1) even, far, have, how, not, realize, walked, will, you, you를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: you will not even realize how far you have walked
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- 주어 + 조동사 부정: you(주어) + will not(~하지 않을 것이다) + even(조차)
- 동사: realize(깨닫다)
- '얼마나 멀리 ~했는지'는 '의문사 how far + 주어 + 동사' 어순의 간접의문문으로 써요: how + far + you + have + walked
- have walked는 지금까지 걸어 온 결과를 나타내는 현재완료예요
- 순서대로 놓으면 you / will / not / even / realize / how / far / you / have / walked
det.tip: will not even realize(깨닫지도 못할 것이다) + 간접의문문 how far you have walked(얼마나 멀리 걸었는지)

questions.wa: you will not even realize how far you have walked
accept: you will not even realize how far you have walked
